title: On the fairness of single round-robin tournaments: Evidence from European football
abstract: arXiv:2610.21296v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Single round-robin tournaments are widely regarded as unfair because of their home-away imbalance: some competitors play more home games than the others. Therefore, most sports leagues are played in a double round-robin format. However, some European football leagues contain a single round-robin (sub)tournament. To test whether empirical data can validate their unfairness, we construct a unique database and develop a strength of schedule metric based on Elo ratings with favourable theoretical properties. In contrast to the robust impact of relative team strength, the strength of schedule is found to have no significant effect on the number of points scored under the assumption of a league-specific home advantage. Consequently, the theoretical unfairness is not a serious issue in practice, or the standard approach of modelling home advantage in Elo ratings might need to be reconsidered.

translated_title: 论单循环赛制的公平性：来自欧洲足球的证据
translated_abstract: 单循环赛制由于主客场失衡而被普遍认为是不公平的：一些参赛者比其他参赛者打更多主场比赛。因此，大多数体育联赛采用双循环赛制。然而，一些欧洲足球联赛包含单循环（子）锦标赛。为了检验经验数据能否证实这种不公平性，我们构建了一个独特的数据库，并开发了一种基于Elo等级分的赛程强度指标，该指标具有良好的理论特性。与相对球队实力的稳健影响形成对比，在联赛特定主场优势的假设下，研究发现赛程强度对球队得分数量没有显著影响。因此，理论上的不公平性在实践中并非严重问题，或者Elo等级分中建模主场优势的标准方法可能需要重新考虑。
tldr: 该研究利用基于Elo等级分的赛程强度指标，通过欧洲足球联赛数据分析发现，单循环赛制中主客场失衡导致的赛程强度差异对球队实际得分并无显著影响，表明这种赛制的理论不公平性在实践中可能并非严重问题。
en_tdlr: Using an Elo-based strength of schedule metric on European football data, this study finds that the home-away imbalance in single round-robin tournaments has no significant effect on points scored, suggesting their theoretical unfairness may not be a serious practical issue.
